Output alignment mathematical adaptations

Excalidraw commit 1d4dc2c0e6e476911d0760e9c3cf3694f2d43384:
https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/1d4dc2c0e6e476911d0760e9c3cf3694f2d43384
packages/element/src/align.ts: calculateTranslation arithmetic.
packages/element/src/distribute.ts: nonnegative gap/span arithmetic.
packages/excalidraw/snapping.ts: screen distance/zoom and gap offset arithmetic.
Modified 2026-10-21 for Circuit: immutable OutputLayout units, baseline alignment,
fixed distribution endpoints, negative-gap rejection, axis scales, semantic candidate
priority, hysteresis, visible and nearby references. Scene, bindings, caches and UI omitted.

maxGraph Guide.ts at 8fa78c2f290fa4521de65583e3e93cf3ca838e8d was a structural
reference for independent-axis edge/centre comparisons only. No maxGraph code copied.
https://github.com/maxGraph/maxGraph/blob/8fa78c2f290fa4521de65583e3e93cf3ca838e8d/packages/core/src/view/other/Guide.ts
